title: Coded case file (presence-coding study, draft)
description: DRAFT. One rater's presence codes for one case narrative in the indicator presence-coding study described in docs/study/PROTOCOL.md. The protocol has not been run and no file of this shape containing real codes exists yet. Scope is the People and Facilities matrices only. Single-line string fields forbid carriage returns and line feeds with a leading negative lookahead, so a trailing newline cannot slip past the end anchor.

study_version.description: Version of the study protocol the codes were produced under, for example 0.1.0-draft.

case_id.description: Study-assigned case identifier. Carries no information about the case.

case_title.description: Neutral title of the case narrative as given to raters.

case_class.description: Class assigned by the study coordinator from the public record. Recorded for analysis; raters are not told the class.

sources.description: Public documents the case narrative was drawn from.

narrative_ref.description: Repository-relative path or stable identifier of the case narrative the rater read.

rater_pseudonym.description: Study-assigned pseudonym. Never a name, initials, employer, or credential number.

framework_version.description: Content version of docs/data/framework.json whose indicator wording was coded against.

codes.description: One entry per indicator coded. An indicator may appear at most once per file; the analysis script enforces this.

coded_on.description: Date the rater completed the file, YYYY-MM-DD.

type.description: The three source classes the protocol admits.

indicator_id.description: People (IND-NNNN-NN) or Facilities (IND-FNNNN-NN) indicator ID. Organizations and Infrastructure indicators are outside the study and are rejected.

evidence_passage.description: Verbatim passage from the case narrative that shows the behavior. Required when code is present.

evidence_locator.description: Optional. Paragraph or line reference into the case narrative.

confidence.description: The rater's confidence in this code.

note.description: Optional. Why the rater chose cannot_determine, or which neighbouring indicator was considered.
